reason: Collagen for my joints after training is something I'd actually use, and £18 isn't bad. But it just says 'halal-certified' without saying who certified it, and I've never seen any of the creators I follow use it, so I'm not putting bovine collagen in my coffee on a website's word.
objection: Who certified it? 'Halal-certified' with no certifier named means nothing to me. I want to see the body's name and the certificate, especially for gelatin or collagen from cattle.
would_change_my_mind: The certifying body named on the pouch with the certificate on the site, ideally plus a Muslim creator I trust actually using it for a few weeks.
